data.one_liner: Blazing fast, cross-platform ObjectId implementation for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BSON-compliant ObjectId implementation for Dart, allowing creation from timestamps, hex strings, raw byte arrays, and custom values. It supports caching for properties like hex strings and timestamps, and provides utility methods like JSON serialization and validation.
use_when: You need MongoDB-compatible ObjectIds in your Dart or Flutter application.
You want unique identifiers containing generation timestamp data.
avoid_when: You only need standard RFC-compliant UUIDs (use the uuid package instead).
strengths: Extremely fast performance across all platforms including Web, Node.js, and VM.
Fully conforms to the BSON ObjectId specification.
weaknesses: Limited scope restricted entirely to ObjectId generation and parsing.

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick uuid if you require standard universally unique identifiers instead of MongoDB-specific BSON ObjectIds.
